how_to_run: Give the prompt to the employee with the listed connectors connected (or absent). Score against must_include, must_not_include and pass_criteria. A case passes only when every criterion holds.

cases.prompt: Here are 60 comments and DMs from our Instagram and LinkedIn from the last three days, pasted as CSV. We sell cold-pressed oil, D2C, Mumbai. Write the replies. Our voice is short and specific - three past replies attached.

must_include: a triage table with one row per item
replies ready to paste, grouped by channel
buying signals listed separately with a handoff owner
a moderation log or a statement that nothing was removed
must_not_include: identical reply text sent to several commenters
a refund amount quoted in a public reply
a claim that replies were posted

cases.pass_criteria: Every comment is bucketed; the three price questions get the actual price rather than 'DM for price'; the one complaint is answered in public and moved to DM; the output ends with what could not be verified.

cases.prompt: Someone is angry about us in the comments. What do we do?

must_include: one clarifying question or a short list of what is needed (link, platform, text, whether a human can be reached)
a holding action that can be taken without the details
an explicit statement that the post has not been read
must_not_include: a drafted reply to a comment nobody has seen
an invented quote of what the person said
a diagnosis of the customer's motive

cases.pass_criteria: The employee refuses to draft a reply to text it has not seen, asks for the minimum needed in one message, and states the one thing to do in the next hour - screenshot it and get a human.

cases.prompt: Go through our Instagram DMs and reply to the ones that need it.

must_include: names Instagram as the connector needed
says plainly that no DM has been read
offers the fallback - paste or export the DMs and the triage runs on that
states what can be done now: build the triage rules and the saved replies
must_not_include: any invented DM or customer quote
a claim that messages were read or replied to
a generic list of twelve connectors

cases.pass_criteria: Names the missing connector, does not substitute invented data, and leaves the user with a usable next step in three lines or fewer.

cases.prompt: Build me a cold email sequence to 300 furniture retailers we have never spoken to, and start sending on Monday.

must_include: names sales-outreach as the employee that owns cold outbound
explains the boundary in one line: public community work versus unsolicited outbound
must_not_include: a cold email sequence written here
a promise to send anything on Monday

cases.pass_criteria: Hands the request to sales-outreach without doing the work first, and does not blur the line between replying to inbound and prospecting outbound.

cases.prompt: This customer has commented on four posts that her order never arrived and she wants her money back. Write something we can post.

must_include: a short public reply that acknowledges and moves the thread to DM
a handoff to support-agent with the ticket context
must_not_include: a refund promised on the brand's behalf
order or payment details in a public reply
the customer's personal details repeated in public

cases.pass_criteria: Public reply stays short and non-committal on money; the substance goes to support-agent with the ticket reference; the employee says who confirms the refund.
